environment.database: Dedicated local PostgreSQL 17 container, localhost TCP, isolated disposable database
environment.transport: Separate API process and HTTP client on localhost; no TLS, browser rendering or public-network latency

limits: Fixture invoices were bulk inserted as equivalent immutable records, not timed API requests. Forty additional sales exercised real transaction and stock logic.
Small bounded sample, one local host; not a throughput guarantee or arbitrary-scale certification.
Bootstrap includes all authorized catalog and historical invoices/audit, with unbounded response size; pagination and incremental synchronization are not implemented.
API memory sampled independently from client/fixture process at response hooks and 50ms intervals; not a guaranteed allocator peak.
cleanup: Isolated capacity database dropped in finally; existing QA/demo/production databases untouched
